title: Egg Xylophone
premise: A hen lays eggs onto a xylophone, plinking out a little tune. The last egg is an ostrich egg. It lands in a tuba: BWAAAMP.
visual: Barnyard. A proud hen on a stool. Eggs roll along a toy xylophone with little note shapes popping up. A huge ostrich egg falls into the bell of a tuba. The hen's eyes are wide, feathers blown back.
characterLean: Made for the show's music-drop format: plinks on the build, BWAAAMP on the drop.

motion: 6-8s. Plink, plink, plink, plink (rising scale, sync to the build). Long pause. Giant egg. BWAAAMP on the drop. Hen's feathers blow off and float back down.
notes: Let the editor pitch the plinks to the track's key.
